title: 第1章 黑松林初遇第2章 宗门影令牌
slug: 修仙开局一部手机修为全靠买
content_zh:
青石镇的冬天来得格外早。
十月未过，漫天鹅毛大雪已经压垮了镇口那棵百年老槐的半边枝杈。冷风从北边灌进来，顺着破败的土坯墙缝往人骨头缝里钻，街面上几乎看不见几个活人，只有几条瘦骨嶙峋的野狗趴在屋檐下，眼睛里泛着饿极了的绿光。
刘叙白蹲在一间塌了半边的破庙里，把身上那件洗得发白的粗布长衫又裹紧了些。冷。真他妈的冷。他呵出一口白气，搓了搓冻得僵硬的手指，脑子里第无数次冒出一个念头——穿越这档子事，怎么就没摊上个富贵人家？
三个月了。
他穿越到这个鬼地方整整三个月，至今没能完全适应。前身是个散修，无门无派，修为低得可怜，勉强摸到炼气二层的门槛，靠给人跑腿采药混口饭吃。在一次采药途中遭遇妖兽，重伤不治，一命呜呼，再睁眼就换了个芯子。刘叙白继承了前身零零碎碎的记忆，也继承了这副营养不良、经脉驳杂的躯壳，和口袋里仅剩的三枚下品灵石。
穿越前的记忆还在，但没什么用。他是学计算机的，在这个修士满地走、妖兽多如狗的世界里，连给人修电脑都找不到地方。唯一还能证明他来自另一个世界的，就是那部随着他一起穿越过来的手机。
刘叙白从怀里摸出手机，屏幕幽光亮起，映出他清瘦的脸。没有什么信号，没有什么网络，手机里所有app都打不开，只剩一个从未见过的图标亮着——那是一座古朴的石门虚影，门楣上刻着一个隶书的“墟”字，笔画苍劲，像是从极远古的时代一路烙印下来，光是看着，就让人心里生出一种说不清的悸动。
墟市。
他给这个东西取了个名字，因为它看起来就像个交易市场。点进去之后是一片灰蒙蒙的空间，四面都是模糊的雾气，雾气里漂浮着一排排半透明的货架，货架上陈列着各式各样的东西——丹药、法器、功法、灵材，甚至还有一些他根本看不懂是什么玩意的神秘物品。每一样东西下面都标着价格，用的是灵石计价，最便宜的一枚补气丹也要十枚下品灵石，而他全部身家加起来只有三枚。
最要命的是，这个墟市里大部分商品都是灰色的，根本点不了。只有最外围几排货架亮着微弱的白光，能买的全是炼气期用得上的低级货色，稍微高级一点的东西全锁着，灰扑扑一片，像是嘲讽他这个穷鬼。
刘叙白研究过这件事。据他推测，墟市的解锁范围和他的修为挂钩——炼气期能买炼气期的东西，筑基期大概就能解锁筑基期的货架，以此类推。这个设定本身倒没什么问题，问题是，他现在连炼气二层都摇摇欲坠，随时可能掉回一层。墟市里随便一件能帮上忙的东西都贵得离谱，他那三枚灵石连塞牙缝都不够。
死循环。
刘叙白叹了口气，把手机重新塞回怀里。
外面的雪下得更大了，他从破庙的门洞里往外看了一眼，灰白的天地之间空无一人。他今天出来是为了打听一件事——三天前，镇上的猎户老赵说青石镇往北三十里的黑松林里，有人发现了一株十年份的凝血草，品相极好，采回来能卖至少五十枚下品灵石。刘叙白动了心。凝血草附近八成有妖兽守着，十年份的凝血草至少得对付一头一阶中品的妖兽，以他炼气二层的修为，正面硬刚基本等于送死。但他不算太慌，因为墟市的货架上有一件东西他盯了很久——“敛息符”，能在两个时辰内完全遮蔽自身气息，一阶妖兽根本闻不到，售价刚好三枚下品灵石。
也就是说，他把全部身家砸进去，换一张敛息符，神不知鬼不觉摸到凝血草跟前，摘了就撤，五十枚灵石到手，血赚。
当然，这是最理想的情况。
他做过程序员，知道任何方案都不能只算最优路径。黑松林的地形他只从老赵嘴里听说过，不确定里面到底是什么情况；凝血草的消息也未必只有他一个人知道，万一碰上其他修士，敛息符对人可没用；就算一切顺利，采摘过程中万一出点什么岔子，他这副身板连跑都跑不快。
但再不去，凝血草就要被妖兽自己吞了。
老赵说那株凝血草已经长到了十年，周围的妖兽之所以还没动它，是因为它在等满月之夜吸收最后一口月华，彻底成熟。满月之夜，就是后天。
所以刘叙白必须在这两天之内做出决定。

他在破庙里又蹲了一会儿，把整个计划在脑子里过了一遍又一遍，最后站起来，拍了拍身上的雪，往镇子里走。
青石镇不大，拢共就两条街，百来户人家，其中九成是凡人，零星有几个散修住在这里，修为最高的也不过炼气四层。刘叙白租住的地方在镇子最西边，一间土坯垒的小院，墙皮脱落得斑斑驳驳，院门歪歪斜斜挂着一块木板当门。一个月租金十枚下品灵石，他交不起，所以房东让他干杂活抵房租——挑水、劈柴、打扫院子、帮忙跑腿，每天至少三个时辰。
刘叙白推门进去的时候，院子里站着一个穿着灰布短打的年轻人，手里拎着两壶劣酒，正跟房东老孙头有一搭没一搭地聊天。看见刘叙白进来，那人咧嘴一笑，露出一口不太整齐的牙。
“叙白哥，你回来了？”
这人叫陈砚，跟刘叙白一样是个散修，修为炼气三层，比他高一丁点。陈砚是青石镇本地人，爹娘早年间被妖兽咬死了，他一个人在镇上摸爬滚打长大，什么活儿都干过，什么亏都吃过。这个人最大的特点是务实——务实到有时候让人觉得他有点市侩，但对刘叙白来说，陈砚是他在这个世界上唯一能说上几句话的人。
“嗯，去北边转了转。”刘叙白随口应了一声，接过陈砚递来的酒壶灌了一口，劣酒辣嗓子，但好歹能暖暖身子。
陈砚看了看他的脸色，嘿嘿一笑：“还在想那株凝血草？”
刘叙白没吭声。
“我跟你说，叙白哥，这事我思前想后琢磨了两天，觉得还是悬。”陈砚收起笑容，认真地说，“黑松林那个地方我去过一趟，里面岔路多，阴气重，一阶中品的妖兽少说也有三四头。你这炼气二层的修为进去，万一碰上点意外，连个报信的人都没有。”
“我有办法避开妖兽。”
“什么办法？”
刘叙白沉默了一下，没有细说。他不是不信任陈砚，但他很清楚一件事——在这个世界上，底牌这种东西，知道的人越少越好。这不是对陈砚有什么防备，而是一种基本的生存本能。他穿越三个月，虽然还没经历什么大风大浪，但前身的记忆里那些散修之间翻脸不认人的事情，他已经看过太多了。
陈砚见他沉默，也不追问，只是叹了口气：“行，你心里有数就行。不过你要是真打算去，我把这个给你。”
他从怀里掏出一张皱巴巴的黄色符纸，上面用朱砂画着歪歪扭扭的符文，边缘都磨毛了。
“神行符，下品的，用过一次了，还能再用一回。”陈砚把符纸塞到刘叙白手里，语气随意，但眼神很认真，“万一遇上事，别逞能，贴上就跑。这东西虽然残次，但至少能让你跑得比一阶妖兽快两步。”
刘叙白低头看着手里那张破旧的神行符，心里涌起一股说不清的滋味。他知道陈砚穷得很，这张下品神行符虽然残破，但对一个炼气三层的散修来说，关键时刻能救命。陈砚就这么给了他，甚至没提什么条件。
“谢了。”刘叙白把符纸小心地收好，声音有点发闷。
“谢什么，回头采到凝血草卖了钱，记得请我喝酒就行。”陈砚咧嘴一笑，拍了拍他的肩膀，“走了，明天老孙头的柴火还没劈，我答应了帮他去劈，你要是闲着没事就过来搭把手。”
陈砚走后，刘叙白回到自己那间小屋里，坐在硬邦邦的床板上，又掏出手机翻了翻墟市。敛息符还在货架上挂着，价格没变，三枚下品灵石。他的手指悬在屏幕上方，犹豫了一息，点下了购买。
三枚下品灵石从手机里消失，一张淡青色的符纸凭空出现在他手中。符纸入手微凉，上面画着繁复的银色符文，光是那股若有若无的灵力波动就让刘叙白心里踏实了几分。墟市出品的东西品质确实没得说，这张敛息符比他在外面见过的任何一张都要精良。

他把敛息符和陈砚给的神行符一起贴身收好，又从床底下摸出一把生锈的铁剑，在磨刀石上认认真真磨了半个时辰。剑是前身留下来的，品级连宝器都算不上，但好歹开了刃，砍个妖兽什么的勉强能用。
一切准备妥当，刘叙白吹了灯，躺在床上望着头顶漏风的房梁，脑子里反反复复盘算着明天的计划。
黑松林三十里路，他天亮出发，中午之前能到。尽快找到凝血草，贴上敛息符，摘了就撤，天黑之前赶回来。全程最关键的一步就是找到凝血草之后的采摘环节，妖兽不可能全天候守着，总会有一小段缝隙。他只需要抓住那个缝隙，一切就能搞定。
刘叙白翻了个身，闭上眼睛。
他在心里把这个计划又过了一遍。每一步都推演了，每一个可能出问题的环节都想了应对方案。他觉得问题不大。
content_en:
Winter comes extremely early in Qingshi Town.
October has not yet passed, and the heavy snow has already crushed half of the branches of the century-old locust tree at the entrance of the town. The cold wind came in from the north and penetrated into the cracks of human bones along the cracks of the dilapidated adobe walls. There were almost no living people visible on the street, only a few skinny wild dogs lying under the eaves, their eyes glowing with hungry green light.
Liu Xubai squatted in a dilapidated temple with half of it collapsed, wrapping the coarse cloth gown that had been washed white tighter around him. cold. So damn cold. He let out a breath of white air, rubbed his fingers that were stiff from the cold, and a thought came to his mind for the umpteenth time - how come there is no rich family involved in this time travel?
It’s been three months.
He traveled to this ghost place for three full months, and still hasn't fully adapted. His predecessor was a casual cultivator with no family or sect, and his cultivation level was pitifully low. He could barely reach the threshold of the second floor of Qi Refining, and made a living by running errands and collecting medicines for others. On a way to collect medicine, he encountered a monster and was seriously injured and died. When he opened his eyes again, he had a new core. Liu Xubai inherited the fragmentary memories of his predecessor, as well as this malnourished body with mixed meridians, and the only three low-grade spiritual stones left in his pocket.
The memories from before the time travel are still there, but they are of no use. He majored in computer science, and in this world where monks roamed the ground and monsters were as numerous as dogs, he couldn't even find a place for people to repair their computers. The only thing that can prove that he comes from another world is the mobile phone that traveled with him.
Liu Xubai took out his mobile phone from his arms, and the dim light on the screen lit up, reflecting his thin face. There was no signal, no network, and all the apps on the phone could not be opened. Only an icon that had never been seen before was lit - it was the shadow of a simple stone gate. The lintel was engraved with the word "Xu" in official script. The strokes were vigorous, as if it had been imprinted from the ancient times. Just looking at it gave people an indescribable throbbing in their hearts.
market.
He named the thing because it looked like a marketplace. After clicking in, there was a gray space surrounded by vague mist. Rows of translucent shelves floated in the mist. All kinds of things were displayed on the shelves - elixirs, magic weapons, exercises, spiritual materials, and even some mysterious items that he couldn't understand at all. The price is marked on the bottom of each item, and the price is calculated in spirit stones. The cheapest Qi-Building Pill costs ten low-grade spirit stones, and his total net worth is only three.
The most terrible thing is that most of the products in this market are gray and cannot be clicked at all. Only the outermost rows of shelves were illuminated by a faint white light, and all the items available for purchase were low-end goods that were used during the Qi refining period. The slightly higher-end items were all locked and dusty, as if to mock him, a poor man.
Liu Xubai has studied this matter. According to his speculation, the unlocking scope of the market is linked to his cultivation level - during the Qi refining period, you can buy things in the Qi refining period, and in the foundation building period, you can probably unlock the shelves in the foundation building period, and so on. There is nothing wrong with this setting in itself. The problem is that he is now teetering on the second level of Qi Refining and may fall back to the first level at any time. Anything that could help in the market was ridiculously expensive, and his three spiritual stones were not even enough to fit between his teeth.
Infinite loop.
Liu Xubai sighed and put the phone back into his arms.
The snow outside was falling even harder. He looked out from the doorway of the ruined temple and saw that there was no one between the gray sky and the earth. He came out today to inquire about something - three days ago, the Orion Hunter in the town, Old Zhao, said that in the black pine forest thirty miles north of Qingshi Town, someone discovered a ten-year-old blood clotting grass. It was in excellent condition and could be sold for at least fifty low-grade spiritual stones. Liu Xubai was moved. There are eighty percent monsters guarding the blood-coagulating grass. The ten-year-old blood-coagulating grass has to deal with at least one first-level mid-level monster. With his second-level Qi refining skills, a strong confrontation would basically mean death. But heHe wasn't too panicked, because there was something on the shelf in the market that he had been staring at for a long time - the "Breathing Talisman", which could completely cover one's own aura within two hours. First-order monsters could not smell it at all, and the price was exactly three low-grade spiritual stones.
In other words, he poured all his wealth into it and exchanged it for a breath-absorbing talisman. He unknowingly touched the blood-coagulating grass, picked it up and then withdrew. He got fifty spiritual stones and made a lot of money.
Of course, this is the ideal situation.
He has been a programmer and knows that any solution cannot just be the optimal path. He had only heard about the terrain of the Black Pine Forest from Old Zhao, and was not sure what was going on inside. He might not be the only one who knew about the Blood-Coagulating Grass. If he encountered other monks, the Breath-Absorbing Talisman would be useless against people. Even if everything went well, if something went wrong during the picking process, he would not be able to run fast.
But if you don't go, the blood-coagulating grass will be swallowed by the monster itself.
Old Zhao said that the blood-coagulating grass has been growing for ten years. The reason why the monsters around it haven't touched it yet is because it is waiting for the full moon night to absorb the last bite of moonlight and mature completely. The night of the full moon is the day after tomorrow.
Therefore, Liu Xubai must make a decision within these two days.
He squatted in the ruined temple for a while, going over the whole plan in his mind. Finally he stood up, patted the snow on his body, and walked towards the town.
Qingshi Town is not big, with only two streets, and about a hundred households, 90% of which are mortals. There are a few casual cultivators living here, and the highest cultivation level is only at the fourth level of Qi Refining. The place Liu Xubai rented was in the far west of the town, a small adobe courtyard with peeling walls and a wooden board hanging crookedly on the door. He couldn't afford the monthly rent of ten low-grade spiritual stones, so the landlord asked him to do odd jobs to pay the rent - fetching water, chopping firewood, cleaning the yard, and helping run errands, at least three hours a day.
When Liu Xubai pushed the door open and walked in, there was a young man wearing a gray cloth standing in the yard, holding two bottles of bad wine in his hand, chatting with the landlord, Sun Tou. Seeing Liu Xubai come in, the man grinned, showing a set of uneven teeth.
"Brother Xu Bai, are you back?"
This man's name is Chen Yan. He is a casual cultivator like Liu Xubai. He is at the third level of Qi Refining, which is a little higher than him. Chen Yan is a native of Qingshi Town. His parents were bitten to death by monsters in his early years. He grew up alone in the town. He has done all kinds of work and suffered all kinds of losses. The biggest characteristic of this person is pragmatism - so pragmatic that sometimes people think he is a bit philistine, but for Liu Xubai, Chen Yan is the only person in the world he can say a few words to.
"Well, let's go to the north for a walk." Liu Xubai responded casually, took the wine bottle handed by Chen Yan and took a sip. The bad wine was harsh on the throat, but at least it could warm the body.
Chen Yan looked at his face and smiled: "Still thinking about that blood clotting grass?"
Liu Xubai said nothing.
"I'm telling you, Brother Xu Bai, I've been thinking about this for two days, and I feel it's still up in the air." Chen Yan put away his smile and said seriously, "I've been to that place in the Black Pine Forest. There are many forks in it, the atmosphere is heavy, and there are at least three or four first-level mid-level monsters. If you have a second-level Qi refining level, there won't even be anyone to report the news if something unexpected happens."
"I have a way to avoid monsters."
"What can I do?"
Liu Xubai was silent for a moment and did not elaborate. It's not that he doesn't trust Chen Yan, but he knows one thing very well - in this world, the fewer people who know about trump cards, the better. This is not a defense against Chen Yan, but a basic survival instinct. He traveled through space for three months, and although he hadn't experienced any big storms yet, he had already seen too many incidents in his memory of his predecessor where loose cultivators turned against each other.
Seeing his silence, Chen Yan didn't ask any further questions. He just sighed: "Okay, you just need to know what's going on. But if you really plan to go, I'll give you this.". "
He took out a crumpled yellow rune paper from his arms, with crooked runes drawn on it with cinnabar, and the edges were all frayed.
"The divine walking talisman is of low quality. It has been used once and can be used again. "Chen Yan stuffed the talisman paper into Liu Xubai's hand, his tone was casual, but his eyes were serious, "If something happens to you, don't show off, stick it on and run away. Although this thing is inferior, it can at least allow you to run two steps faster than a first-order monster. "
Liu Xubai lowered his head and looked at the worn-out magical talisman in his hand, feeling an indescribable feeling in his heart. He knew that Chen Yan was very poor. Although this low-grade magical talisman was broken, for a casual cultivator at the third level of Qi refining, it could save his life at critical moments. Chen Yan just gave it to him without even mentioning any conditions.
"Thanks. Liu Xubai carefully put the talisman away, his voice a little muffled.
"Thank you for nothing. I collected the coagulation grass later and sold it for money. Just remember to treat me to a drink. "Chen Yan grinned and patted his shoulder, "Let's go. Tomorrow, Lao Suntou's firewood hasn't been chopped yet. I agreed to help him chop it. If you have nothing to do, come over and help. "
After Chen Yan left, Liu Xubai returned to his small room, sat on the hard bed, and took out his mobile phone to browse the market. The breath gathering charm is still hanging on the shelf, the price has not changed, and there are three low-grade spiritual stones. His finger hovered above the screen, he hesitated, and clicked purchase.
Three low-grade spirit stones disappeared from the phone, and a light cyan talisman appeared out of thin air in his hand. The talisman paper was slightly cold to the touch, and there were complicated silver runes painted on it. Just the faint fluctuation of spiritual power made Liu Xubai feel a little more at ease. The quality of the things produced in the market was indeed unparalleled. This breath-absorbing charm was better than anything he had seen outside.
He put the breath-holding talisman and the magic walking talisman given by Chen Yan away close to his body, took out a rusty iron sword from under the bed, and sharpened it carefully on the whetstone for half an hour. The sword was left over from its predecessor, and it wasn't even considered a treasure, but it was sharp enough to be able to cut down a monster or something.
When everything was ready, Liu Xubai turned on the lamp and lay on the bed, looking at the drafty beams above his head, thinking over and over in his mind about tomorrow's plans.
Thirty miles into the black pine forest, he set out at dawn and could arrive before noon. Find the blood coagulation grass as soon as possible, put a breath-absorbing charm on it, move out after picking it, and come back before dark. The most critical step in the whole process is the picking process after finding the blood coagulation grass. Monsters cannot guard it around the clock, and there will always be a small gap. All he had to do was grab that gap and everything would be done.
Liu Xubai turned over and closed his eyes.
He went over the plan in his mind. Every step has been deduced, and a solution has been thought out for every possible problem. He didn't think it was a big problem.
